title: Look-Ahead-Bench: a Standardized Benchmark of Look-ahead Bias in Point-in-Time LLMs for Finance

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating LLM-based trading agents across two temporally distinct periods (an in-sample period within the model's training window and an out-of-sample period post-cutoff) and calculating an 'Alpha Decay' metric to quantify the performance drop caused by the absence of memorized future data.
